text:
oak_tech_rep: Hey team — our rerank calls started failing this morning. We get a 400 with `payload too large` when sending the same batch that worked last week. No code changes on our side. Can someone help? :frowning:

alex_support: Hi! Sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the exact error body and the payload size (docs count, avg doc length or token estimate)? Also which model/endpoint you hit?

oak_tech_rep: Error body is just `{"error":"payload too large"}` from the API. We call POST /v1/rerank with model: "rerank-1-large". We send ~750 docs (they're long help articles, ~2.5k chars each). Here's the curl we used (redacted keys):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"query":"How do I reset my token?","docs":["<doc1...>", "<doc2...>", ..., "<doc750...>"]}'
```

No further details returned. We need to surface which limit we hit so we can paginate client-side.

alex_support: Thanks — escalating to eng to clarify exact limit semantics. Ethan, Priya — tagging you for triage. Customer is seeing a vague `payload too large` on rerank with ~750 long docs. They need guidance and better error messaging. @opsbot will attach logs in a sec. :eyes:

opsbot: Attached request metadata: content_length=~1.9MB, docs_count=752, avg_doc_chars=2460, model=rerank-1-large, request_id=req_01F9X2K

e than_engineering: Thanks for the data. Quick summary from runtime logs for req_01F9X2K: we abort early when either total_docs > 512 OR combined token_count > 262144 OR a single doc > 65536 tokens. Current enforcement is at the gateway layer and the error bubble-up is blunt (`413/400` generic). It looks like the customer trip multiple limits: docs_count=752 > 512 and combined_token estimate ~1.2M > 262144.

oak_tech_rep: Ah — that's helpful. Can we get that info in the API error? Right now we can't programmatically decide to split by doc count vs doc length.

ethan_engineering: Totally. From eng side I propose the API change to return structured limit info similar to: 

```
HTTP 400
{
  "error": "rerank.limit_exceeded",
  "details": {
    "reason": "max_docs",
    "max_docs": 512,
    "provided_docs": 752
  }
}
```

or when token budget exceeded:

```
HTTP 413
{
  "error": "rerank.limit_exceeded",
  "details": {
    "reason": "total_tokens",
    "max_tokens": 262144,
    "provided_tokens": 1223456
  }
}
```

This would let SDKs/kb automatically split batches.

priya_sre: I agree but note two operational things: (1) gateway currently normalizes many upstream errors to 413/400 for security and to avoid fingerprinting kernel internals. (2) we should be careful exposing exact token counts for user content in error payloads — data leak risk. We can return counts limited to a coarse bucket or just the limit name and the provided count truncated to e.g. ">1e6".

alex_support: Good point. Customer would prefer precise actionable info, but security/compliance matters. We need a compromise UX that helps customers and keeps data safe.

ethan_engineering: Proposal: change to a structured error with three fields (reason, limit, provided_estimate) where provided_estimate is rounded and flagged as `approx`. Example:

```
{
  "error": "rerank.limit_exceeded",
  "reason": "docs_count",
  "limit": 512,
  "provided_estimate": "~750"
}
```

That avoids returning raw tokenized content or per-doc snippets. SDKs can still branch on `reason`.

oak_tech_rep: That would be great. Also can we get a short KB article explaining the rerank limit semantics: per-request max_docs=512, per-doc soft size, total token budget for model family, and recommended client-side batching examples? Our support folks can send it to customers.

alex_support: I'll draft a KB and sample client batching snippet once eng confirms the final error shape. Ethan — any rough ETA for a small gateway change with that structured error and a test?

ethan_engineering: If we scope it to only change the gateway mapping (no model/runtime changes), I can do a PR this week and a canary deploy early next week. Will need QA on SRE side for telemetry.

priya_sre: I'll own QA. Two test cases: (A) docs_count > limit (should return reason=docs_count) (B) single doc too big (reason=doc_too_large with offending_doc_index if possible). For (B) I ask we keep offending_doc_index optional and only return it when customer opts in or when doc hash is safe — otherwise just return index as `>1000` style? We need to avoid echoing content back.

ethan_engineering: We can return the index (integer) without content; that shouldn't be a leak. Good call. I'll add that to the spec. Example for single doc: `{"error":"rerank.limit_exceeded","reason":"doc_too_large","limit":65536,"offending_doc_index":23}`

oak_tech_rep: Perfect. Also please add a human-friendly message that support can paste: "Your rerank request exceeded the maximum allowed number of documents (512). Try sending fewer docs per request or use pagination/batching. See: <KB link>"

alex_support: I'll coordinate on the KB and include the new error examples and a tiny JS helper to split arrays into chunks of 512. Draft snippet: 

```
function chunkDocs(docs, max=512){
  const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<docs.length;i+=max) out.push(docs.slice(i,i+max)); return out;
}
```

ethan_engineering: One more note: we should also update SDKs to translate `reason` -> specific exception classes (e.g., RerankDocsLimitError, RerankTokensLimitError) to make it easy for app devs to retry with altered payloads. I'll open a follow-up issue.

priya_sre: Ops note — we should add a circuit-breaker metric for frequent `rerank.limit_exceeded` errors per API key to detect misbehaving clients. I'll put that on the SRE board.

oak_tech_rep: Thank you all — this resolves the immediate ask. I'll tell the customer the short-term workaround: split docs into <=512 chunks and if you still see errors, try trimming long docs or send metadata-only reranks. Also request that we prioritize the structured error for next week if possible. :pray:

alex_support: Thanks @oak_tech_rep. I'll update customer when eng changes land and post the KB link here. Closing loop once canary is green. :thumbsup:

ethan_engineering: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/pull/3241 — includes tests and spec. Will request review from @priya_sre.

priya_sre: Reviewing now. Quick test shows expected mapping for docs_count and doc_too_large. Will run canary tomorrow morning.

opsbot: Canary deploy started at 2026-03-16T07:30:12Z for PR 3241.

alex_support: Saved KB draft to internal doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/support/kb/rerank-limits (will paste public link when ready).

oak_tech_rep: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll try the chunking workaround and revert if anything else pops up. :clap:

ethan_engineering: Follow-up actions: (1) gateway structured error change (PR 3241) (2) SDK mapping & docs (3) KB article + support template (4) SRE metric for spikes. I'll add the tasks to the rerank epic.

alex_support: Noted. Marking this thread resolved for support.

--- end of thread ---
